<!-- dynamo-static -->
### Static checks ❌ — fix these, then push (the full review runs once these pass)

|  | Check | Details |
|---|---|---|
| ❌ | task.toml category/objective/artifact labels are from the taxonomy | FAIL submission/task/task.toml: [metadata].task_objective has invalid value(s): ['recover'];FAIL submission/task/task.toml: [metadata].artifact_type has invalid value(s): ['binary_file', 'media_file'] |
| ❌ | verifier writes /logs/verifier/reward.txt (not pre-created) | FAIL submission/task/tests: nothing writes /logs/verifier/reward.txt — the verifier must write 1 (pass) or 0 (fail) there |
| ❌ | tests/ has test_outputs.py and test.sh runs it | FAIL submission/task/tests/test.sh: test.sh does not invoke test_outputs.py (run it, e.g. `pytest --ctrf … /tests/test_outputs.py`). |


<details><summary>Passed checks</summary>

|  | Check |
|---|---|
| ✅ | task.toml has all required metadata fields |
| ✅ | all required task.toml fields are filled in (no placeholders) |
| ✅ | task slug is concise (<=3 tokens) |
| ✅ | instruction.md uses absolute paths |
| ✅ | instruction.md is <= 1500 tokens (o200k_base) |
| ✅ | expected output files are documented in instruction.md |
| ✅ | allow_internet is true |
| ✅ | agent/verifier timeouts within the cap |
| ✅ | gpu_types are canonical names |
| ✅ | Dockerfile base image is a pre-approved image (non-approved → warning) |
| ✅ | non-trivial build context has a .dockerignore |
| ✅ | no source embedded via Dockerfile heredoc |
| ✅ | no apt-get upgrade in Dockerfiles |
| ✅ | no broad recursive chmod in Dockerfiles |
| ✅ | Dockerfile does not COPY solution/ or tests/ |
| ✅ | Dockerfile apt hygiene (no pins, update + cleanup) |
| ✅ | Dockerfile is not pinned to a CPU platform |
| ✅ | no bare nproc (use a fixed CPU count) |
| ✅ | pip/uv installs are version-pinned |
| ✅ | verifier does not fetch external resources at trial time |
| ✅ | tests/test.sh installs nothing at verify time |

</details>
